name: Tracking using EuDX algorithm
summary: Tracks white matter streamlines with DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_track_local using the EuDX algorithm on DIPY peaks-and-metrics, a stopping image (FA) and a seed mask, and outputs a .trk tractogram.
description: Wraps the DIPY 1.1.1 command-line workflow dipy_track_local with --tracking_method eudx. Use it after fitting a DIPY reconstruction model that produced a peaks-and-metrics (PAM) file. It needs the PAM file, a tensor dataset whose FA image is used as the stopping criterion (thresholded by stopping_thr), and a binary seed mask; the result is written as output/track.trk. Sibling Apps in the same repository run the other dipy_track_local algorithms.

inputs.description: DIPY peaks-and-metrics (PAM) file with the fiber orientation peaks used for tracking.
Tensor dataset; only its FA image is passed to dipy_track_local as the stopping image (md, rd and ad are mapped but not used).
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space and grid as the PAM file and the seed mask.

inputs.description: Binary mask; streamlines are seeded inside it with seed_density seeds per voxel dimension.

parameters.description: Tracking algorithm passed to dipy_track_local --tracking_method; fixed to 'eudx' for this App.
If True, uses a binary stopping criterion. If the provided `stopping_files` are not binary, `stopping_thr` will be used to binarize the images.

Threshold applied to stopping volume's data to identify where
tracking has to stop (default 0.25).

Number of seeds per dimension inside voxel (default 1).
For example, seed_density of 2 means 8 regularly distributed points
in the voxel. And seed density of 1 means 1 point at the center
of the voxel.

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
